Meeting Date:                  10/26/2022
Sponsor(s):                    Burnett (27)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 1-1 at 452-466 N Artesian
                              Ave and 2429-2439 W Grand Ave - App No. 8789
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all ofthe M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
1-1 in the area bound by:

      West Grand Avenue; North Artesian Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West
      Hubbard Street; the alley next westeast of and parallel to North Artesian Avenue; the
      alley next south of West Grand Avenue; a line 82 feet west of and parallel to North
      Artesian Avenue as measured along the north right-of-way line of the alley next south of
      West Grand Avenue in a northeasterlynorthwesterly direction perpendicular to West
      Grand Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




Common Address:
452-466 N. Artesian Avenue
2429-2439 W. Grand Avenue
